en: The catalog of scriptures, ritual manuals,
and other texts brought by Vinaya Master Huìyùn totals two hundred and twenty-two fascicles;
seventy-six of these are newly arrived.

*The Sūtra on the Ritual Manual for Reciting the Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Daixingzhi of Daxingshan Temple. *The Thirty-Four Methods for the Separate Practice of Accomplishment within the Uṣṇīṣavijayā-yoga*, one fascicle. *The Essential Methods for the Recitation Ritual of the Extraordinary Primordial Golden Wheel Uṣṇīṣa*, one fascicle. *The Sūtra Spoken by the Buddha on the Most Victorious Vajra Dhāraṇī of the Life-Prolonging Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, Empowered by the Radiance of the Heart of All Tathāgatas*, one fascicle; translated by Amoghavajra of Great Extensive Wisdom. *Annotated Commentary on the Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī*, one fascicle; translated by three houses [of masters]. *The First Explanatory Key to the Meaning of the Secret Mind-Ground Dharma Gate of the Vajraśekhara Mahāyoga*. The above six fascicles constitute one volume.

One section in two fascicles: The Yoga Method for the Recitation of the Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śubhakarasiṃha; and the first fascicle of the *Vajrabhairava-saṃgraha-vipula-vidhi-kalpa-avalokiteśvara-bodhisattva-trikāla-parama-hṛdaya-vidyārāja-sūtra*, translated by the Great Widely Wise Amoghavajra. These three fascicles constitute one bundle.

*The Scripture on the Compendium of the True Realm of All Buddhas*, one fascicle in three volumes, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Prajñā; *The Scripture Spoken by Avalokiteśvara on the Heart Mantra of Tārā*, one fascicle. The above four fascicles constitute one bundle.
*The Ritual Manual for the Recitation of the Dhāraṇī of the Benevolent King’s Protection of the Nation Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra*, one fascicle;
translated by Tripiṭaka Master Amoghavajra. *The Ritual Manual for the Recitation of the Blue-Necked Compassionate King Avalokiteśvara of the Vajraśekhara Yoga*, one fascicle;
translated by Tripiṭaka Master Vajrabodhi. *The Recitation of the Yoga of Samantabhadra-Vajrasattva*.
*Vidhi-vidhāna* (Ritual Manual), one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Amoghavajra.
*Vajraśekhara-sūtra-prathama-yoga-mahāsukha-vajrasattva-japa-vidhi*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Amoghavajra.
*Vajraśekhara-yoga-arahasya*, one fascicle. *Vajraśekhara-yoga-trisaptatidevatotpatti-artha*, one fascicle. *Bodhicitta*.
*Yi* (Meaning), one fascicle; *Buddhabhāṣita-bhadrakarī-dārikā-sūtra*, one fascicle;
*Buddhabhāṣita-bhadrakarī-dārikā-sūtra-japa-vidhi*, one fascicle. The above nine fascicles constitute one bundle.

*The Sūtra of the Ritual for the Accomplishment of the Bodhisattva Ārya-Krodhavajrakumāra*, one volume in three fascicles, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Amoghavajra; *The Ritual for the Yoga Contemplative Wisdom of the King of the Lotus Sūtra’s Excellent Accomplishment*, one volume, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Amoghavajra; *The Extremely Secret Dharma-Gate of the Accomplishment of Trailokyavijaya-Vajrayoga*, one volume; and *The Separate Practice of the Functional Efficacy of the Dhāraṇī for Upholding the World as Taught by the Omniscient One*, one volume, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Yijing. These six volumes constitute one bundle.

The *Buddhabhāṣita-vajraśekhara-yoga-saṃkṣiptoddhṛta-japa-sūtra*, one volume in six fascicles; the *Ārya-yamāntaka-krodharāja-siddha-mahāpratyaya-japa-vidhi*, one volume; the *Vajrapāṇi-prabhābhiṣeka-parama-sthāna-mudrā-ārya-acala-krodharāja-japa-vidhi*, one volume; and the *Acala-dūta-dhāraṇī-guhyavidhi*, one volume—these nine volumes above constitute one bundle.

The *Vajrabhairava-samāja-vipula-kalpa-avalokiteśvara-bodhisattva-trikāla-parama-hṛdaya-mantra-rāja-sūtra*, lower fascicle, translated by Amoghavajra Tripiṭaka Master; The *Mahāprabhāva-uṣṇīṣacakra-mahāvidyārāja-sūtra*, one volume in two fascicles, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Ajitaśrī from Northern India; The *Ārya-mañjuśrī-bodhisattva-rahasya-aṣṭākṣara-dhāraṇī-caryā-maṇḍala-anupūrva-kalpa*, one fascicle, translated by the Śramaṇa Bodhibhadra, a Tripiṭaka Master from Central India, with the assistance of Jingzhi Jin'gang; The *Ekākṣara-uṣṇīṣarāja-japa-kalpa*, one fascicle, translated based on the Sūtra Expounded in the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven Palace; The above four fascicles constitute one bundle.

The *Buddhabhāṣita-sarvatathāgata-prabhāsa-jvālā-cintāmaṇi-mudrā-hṛdaya-prabhāsa-vijaya-pratyaṅgirā-dhāraṇī-sūtra*, one volume in three fascicles; and the *Mahātejas-ugra-ucchuṣma-sādhana-vidhi*, one volume. The above four volumes constitute a single set.

*The Lotus-Bhūtaḥṛdaya Bodhisattva Recitation*, one fascicle; compiled by the Tripiṭaka Master Vajrabodhi of South India, from the *Essential Manual on the Recitation Section*. *The Essential Manual for Recitation Sutra Spoken by Mahāvairocana Buddha*, one fascicle; translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Bodhivajra. *The Mañjuśrī-Yamāntaka-Vajra Dhāraṇī*, one fascicle. *The Dhāraṇī of the Hungry Ghosts*, one fascicle. *The Method for the Recitation of Tārā Bodhisattva from the Vajraśekhara Sūtra*, one fascicle. The above five fascicles constitute one bundle.

The *Rājamañjuśrī-sūtra*, one fascicle in three volumes; the *Vajra-nāmadheya of the Garbhadhātu Teachings*, one fascicle; the *Vajra-nāmadheya of the Vajradhātu*, one fascicle; the *Meaning of the Supreme Bodhicitta Precepts for Bestowing Empowerment*, one fascicle; the *Sūtra of the Three Shelves*, one fascicle; the *Essential Methods for Separate Practice*, one fascicle; the *Maṇḍala of the Eight Great Bodhisattvas*, one fascicle; the *Seal of the Bodhisattva Who Turns the Wheel of Dharma upon the Mere Arising of the Thought [of Enlightenment]*, one fascicle; and the *Text for the Confession of Precepts according to the Instructions of the Supreme Vehicle*, one fascicle. These nine fascicles above constitute one bundle.
The *Brief Method for the Recitation of the Maitreya Bodhisattva’s Yoga* in one fascicle, two volumes; the above constitutes one bundle.
The *Susiddhikara Ritual for Offerings* in one fascicle, two volumes;

the *Secret Instructions on Receiving the Bodhicitta Ground of the Supreme Vehicle*, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śubhakarasiṃha based on the Esoteric Teachings and recorded by his disciple Yi Xing; the *Mahā-vidyā-śrī-sūtra*... [etc. in one fascicle, three volumes.

One fascicle: The Five-Limb Recitation Method of the Vairocana Sūtra’s Essential and Swift Gate; One fascicle: The Consecration Ritual for the *Sarvanetravyādhi-viśodhana-dhāraṇī-sūtra*, translated by Amoghavajra; One fascicle: The Concise Recitation Method of the Five Buddha-Uṣṇīṣas of the Golden Wheel, Commonly Used for All Buddha-Uṣṇīṣa Honored Ones; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī; [Mahā]māyūrī Vidyārājñī;

*The Brief Method for Recitation*, one fascicle; translated by Amoghavajra. *The Ritual Manual for the Yoga Practice and Contemplation of the Heart Mantra of the Holy Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva*, one fascicle;

translated by Amoghavajra. *The Brief Ritual Manual for the Six-Month Observance of the Vidyādhara Precepts and Recitation from the Commentary on the Mahāvairocana Tathāgata’s Sūtra on Attaining Buddhahood*, one fascicle; from the Northern Sūtra Hall of Jingzhang Temple.
Composed with utmost reverence by the śramaṇa Wéijǐn: the "Five Mudrās of the Fundamental Great Paritrāṇā" (Dàsuíqiú), one scroll, though not yet verified;
the ten preceding scrolls constitute one fascicle. *The Vajraśekhara-kūṭāgāra-sarvayoga-yoginī-sūtra*, one scroll, translated by Vajrabodhi.
*The Mahāsukha-vajra-amoghasiddhi-tattva-...* [text fragment].
The *Samayatantra-prajñāpāramitā-naya-vyākhyā*, one volume in two fascicles;
the above three volumes constitute one bundle.
The *Xuanjing suiyao jing* (The Sūtra of the Profound Mirror of Planets and Constellations), one volume; the *Mahāmāyāvajra-mahāmṛta-kaṇḍali-jvālāmālinī*.
*The Sūtra of the Vajra-Buddha-Uṣṇīṣa*, one fascicle; translated by Xingmoqi. *The Heart Sūtra of the Prajñāpāramitā*, one fascicle;

[translated from] the Sanskrit manuscript at Liquan Monastery by the Tripitaka Master Prajña. *Sanskrit Verses of Praise for the Tathāgata Mahāvairocana’s Bodhi*, [translated from] the Sanskrit manuscript.
*A Brief Praise of the Heart of Buddha Vairocana*. [Record of] Śākyamuni Buddha’s Attainment of Enlightenment at Bodhimaṇḍa.
The Praise of the Thousand-Spoked Wheel Mark on the Soles of the Feet of Śākyamuni Tathāgata for Subduing Māra; the Mantra and Praise of the Eight Classes of Beings, including Devas and Nāgas;
the Praise of the Triple Gem; the Praise of the Lotus Family; the Praise of the Vajra Family; the Praise of Cintāmaṇicakra; the Praise of Auspiciousness;
the Praise of the One Hundred and Eight Names of Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva; and the *Vajraśekhara-yoga-paṭhita-sūtra*.
One fascicle of the newly translated *Suvarṇaprabhāsottama-sūtra Dhāraṇī*, one fascicle [of other dhāraṇīs];
the above twelve sections of hymns together with two sūtras are combined into one fascicle.
One fascicle of the *Ākāśagarbha-bhāvanā-vidhi*, one fascicle of the *Amitāyus-tathāgata-bhāvanā-vidhi*, and the *Nirvāṇa* [Sūtra].

*Jing shisi yin qi dan zhang tu* (Diagram of the Fourteen Vowels and Seven Consonants), one fascicle; *Qi dan fan zi* (Seven Consonants in Sanskrit Script), one fascicle; *Qi dan ji* (Record of the Seven Consonants), one fascicle;

*Dafiluzhena guangda yigui zhenyan* (Mantra of the Extensive Ritual of Mahāvairocana), one fascicle; *Da suiqiu jing* (Sūtra of the Great Parittā), one fascicle; *Jingang jiemojing* (Vajrakarma Sūtra), one fascicle;
*Dafoding rulai da daochang yigui* (Ritual of the Great Maṇḍala of the Tathāgata Uṣṇīṣavijayā), one fascicle; *Yin sui* (Seals Following).

*Qiu tuoluoni* (Seeking Dhāraṇīs), one fascicle; *Yin da foding tuoluoni* (Seal of the Great Uṣṇīṣa Dhāraṇī), seven fascicles; *Dalu jin'gang zongchi tuoluoni jing* (Sūtra on the Great Wheel Vajra Total-Holding Dhāraṇī), one fascicle;
*Jianli mantuluo fa* (Method for Establishing Maṇḍalas), one fascicle;

and *Huilin yi jiao lue shu jin'gangding jing manjusuli pusa wuzi xin tuoluoni pin* (Huilin’s Brief Exposition Based on the Teachings of the Chapter on the Manjusri Bodhisattva Wordless Heart Dhāraṇī from the Vajraśekhara Sūtra), one fascicle.
*The Sūtra on the Five-Syllable Recitation of Mañjuśrī Yoga*, translated by Tripitaka Master Vajrabodhi of South India, one fascicle.
*The Ten Amṛta Mantras of the Tathāgata Amitāyus*, one fascicle.
*The Sūtra Spoken by the Buddha on the Northern King Vaiśravaṇa, the Amṛta Prince Nāṭakubjara, the Secret-Treasury King, Whose Heart’s Wishes are Fulfilled and Who Saves*, [one fascicle].
*The Dhāraṇī of the Fundamental Gathering of Sentient Beings*, one fascicle; *The Ritual Manual for the Mantra of the Blazing Buddha-Uṣṇīṣa of Majestic Virtue and Radiance*, one fascicle;
*The Buddha-Spoken Great Vajra Fragrant Victorious Dhāraṇī*, one fascicle; *The General Explanation and Praise of the Meaning of Dhāraṇīs*, one fascicle;
*The Vajratuṇḍa Rite*, one fascicle; translated by Amoghavajra Tripiṭaka Master; *Hārītī* [one fascicle].
One fascicle of the *Dīpaṃkara-mātṛ-mantra-dharmaparyāya*, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Amoghavajra;
one fascicle of the *Samantabhadra-bodhisattva-caryāpraṇidhāna-stotra*; one work in three fascicles of the *Mahāmāyūrī-vidyārājñī-sūtra*; one fascicle of the *Susthitamati-saṃkṣiptavidhi*;
one sheet of the *Kṣitigarbha-mantra*; seven fascicles of the *Vināyaka-vidhi*; one fascicle of the *Tilaka-samādhi-vidhi*; and the *Mahāsvayaṃbhū*... [text continues].
*Devī-sūtra*, one fascicle; *Homa-vidhi*, one fascicle; *Praise and Repentance Text for the Names of the Thirty-five Buddhas*, one fascicle;
*Brief Compendium of Mudrās and Mantras with Explanations of Their Meanings*, one fascicle; *Dharmadharmatā-vibhaṅga-śāstra* (Sanskrit manuscript), one fascicle;
*Triṃśikā-vijñaptimātratā-siddhi* (Sanskrit manuscript), one fascicle; *The Supernatural Transformations of Maheśvara, the Great Sovereign King*.
One fascicle on the Method for Recitation of the Celestial Maiden of Artisanry;

One fascicle on the Secret Heart-Mantra Accomplishment Method among the Various Rites of the Great Vidyārāja Mañjuśrī’s Swift Accomplishment and the Beautiful Woman; One fascicle on the Newly Compiled Ritual for Bathing the Image;
One fascicle on the Dharma of the Five-Crested Mañjuśrī; The Holy One, Acala, the Tattvasamaya Recitation...
*Chanting the Secret Dharma*, three fascicles combined into one; *The Method for Fulfilling Wishes of Uṣṇīṣa*, one fascicle; *The Concise Extract from the Vajraśekhara Sūtra*, one fascicle;
*The King of Teachings of the Vajraśekhara Sūtra*, one fascicle; *The Bhagavat’s Discourse on the Dhāraṇī of the One-Knot Honored One*, one fascicle;
*The Dhāraṇī Method of the Goddess Ratnagarbhā*, one fascicle; *Annotated Commentary on the Great Buddha-Uṣṇīṣa Dhāraṇī*.
One fascicle on the Bhikṣuṇī; one fascicle on the Swift Threefold Verification of the Dharma of Maheśvara, Garuḍa, and Aviddha;
one fascicle on the *Buddhabhāṣita-ārya-maṇibhadra-bodhisattva-dhāraṇī-sūtra*, also titled the *Jala-vaśavartin-bodhisattva-sūtra*;
one fascicle on the *Buddhabhāṣita-triṭiṅku-sūtra*; and the *Vajraśekhara-tri-*.
*Samādhi-vidhi*, one fascicle; translated and annotated by Vajra Tripiṭaka. *Mahākaruṇā-dhāraṇī*, one sheet. *Catur-siddhi-vidhi*, one fascicle.

*Vimalaprabhāsa-mantra*, one fascicle. *Sarva-mantra-rāja-saṃgraha*, one fascicle. *Vajra*.

one fascicle of the *Samantabhadrapraṇidhānarāja*; one fascicle of the *Anantamukha-aṣṭākṣara*; one fascicle of the *Suvarṇacakroṣṇīṣa-śāstra*; one fascicle of the *Mahoṣṇīṣa-mantra*;
and the *Praise of the Names of the Sixteen Bodhisattvas and One Hundred and Eight [Deities]* and the *Thirty-seven Honored Ones*.

one fascicle of the *Saddharmapuṇḍarīka-sūtra-rāja-brahma-akṣara-mantra* (Sanskrit-Syllable Mantra of the Supreme King of Sutras, the Golden Light); one fascicle of the commentary [on the above]; two fascicles of the *Vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-sūtra*;

one fascicle of the Imperial Commentary [on the Vajracchedikā]; one fascicle of the commentary by Master Jñānagupta of Mount Niutou in Jiangning County; and one fascicle of the *Bhadrakalpika-sūtra-kārikā* (Verses on the Sutra of the Auspicious Aeon), composed by Bodhisattva Vasubandhu.

One fascicle: *Commentary on the Verses of the Chapter on Kalpas* translated by Yijing; one fascicle: *Record of the Chapter on Kalpas*; one fascicle: *Subcommentary on the Chapter on Kalpas*; one fascicle:

*The Explication of the Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra*, one fascicle, two volumes; *The Eulogy on the Imperial Edict for the Commentary on the Saṃghāṭa Sūtra*, compiled by the śramaṇa Daoyin;

and the *Outline of the Nanshan Commentary*, one fascicle, along with the *Outline of the Record of Searching for the Profound*.

The *Tenryaku Goki* states:
On the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month of the third year of the Ōwa era.
The Minister of the Department of Affairs, Genchō,
ordered the Courtier Enkō to submit a memorial regarding a copy of the *Shingon-mokuroku* (Catalogue of Esoteric Mantras) offered by Anshō-ji Temple.
He further instructed the monk Enshō to inquire whether this was indeed a rare occurrence, and so forth.
I fear that the right-hand column is the original catalog.

therefore, I have recorded it here for future reference.
